id: CH14
book: 3
title: The Convergence | Phase 4: The Convergence

timeline_anchors:
  - Year 10,549 M11 D11: Ritual Begins
  - Year 10,549 M11 D11 (dusk): Manifestation of the Nephilim
  - Following days: purification operations complete

logline:
  The ritual detonates exactly as promised: simultaneous environmental extremes fracture the collective network while the Nephilim manifest anyway. They erase Anunnaki corruption with clinical indifference, including the allied Brajor, and the alliance breaks when Korrhan severs connection.

primary_conflicts:
  - Pain-driven blame spirals (the Sundering’s perfect harvest condition).
  - Command problem: Nephilim don’t need clear orders, but fractured minds can’t coordinate outcomes.
  - “Ally collateral”: Brajor deaths become a tribal wedge.

mechanics_seeds:
  - Ritual Space Encounter: survival under multi-axis environmental hazards.
  - Blame Intrusions: random “accusation thoughts” injected into collective chat; players must counter them.
  - Collateral Ethics: decision points around accepting help from “tainted origin” allies (Brajor) knowing purifiers won’t care.
  - Permanent Scar System: early-exit from convergence yields lasting debuffs by faction.
